exercises.title: U3 听力·对话 Which Sport to Try
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Mia: The school sports club is open to everyone this term. Which sport will you try, Tom?
Tom: I think I'll try basketball. I really like team games.
Mia: Basketball is great. You have to work closely with your teammates.
Tom: That's exactly why I like it. What about you, Mia?
Mia: I want to join the swimming team. I like training on my own.
Tom: Swimming is hard work. You have to get up so early.
Mia: I know, but getting up early every day really pays off in the end.
Tom: That's a good attitude. Good luck with it!
exercises.translation_cn: Mia 问 Tom 这学期想尝试哪项运动;Tom 想打篮球,喜欢团队比赛,因为要和队友紧密配合;Mia 想加入游泳队,喜欢独自训练;Tom 说游泳很辛苦要早起;Mia 说每天早起最终很有回报。

questions.stem: Which sport does Tom want to try?
Why does Tom like that sport?

options: She can play with a big team.
She likes training on her own.

questions.stem: What does Mia say about getting up early?
options: It is a waste of time.

exercises.title: U3 听力·短文 Faster, Higher, Stronger
exercises.speaker: uk_male
transcript: The motto of the Olympic Games is 'Faster, Higher, Stronger'.
These three words do not only describe winning medals.
They remind every athlete to keep improving a little each day.
Training hard, staying calm and never giving up all matter.
In this spirit, taking part can be just as important as winning.
exercises.translation_cn: 奥林匹克的格言是'更快、更高、更强';这三个词不仅指赢得奖牌,更提醒每位运动员每天都进步一点;刻苦训练、保持冷静、永不放弃都很重要;本着这种精神,参与有时和获胜同样重要。

questions.stem: What is the motto of the Olympic Games?
What do the three words NOT only describe?
What do the words remind athletes to do?
Which of these does the passage say matters?
What can be just as important as winning?

exercises.title: U3 听力·对话 Going to the Match
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Ben: There's a big basketball match this Saturday. Do you want to come?
Sara: I'd love to! Which two teams are playing?
Ben: Our city team is playing against last year's champions.
Sara: Wow, that will be a tough game. Our team lost to them before.
Ben: Yes, but they have trained really hard since then.
Sara: Then it should be an exciting match. What time does it start?
Ben: At seven in the evening. Shall we meet at the gate at half past six?
Sara: Perfect. I'll see you there. I really hope our team wins this time!
exercises.translation_cn: Ben 邀请 Sara 周六去看一场篮球大赛;对阵双方是本市球队和去年的冠军;Sara 说这会是一场硬仗,本队以前输过;Ben 说本队此后刻苦训练;比赛晚上七点开始,两人约六点半在门口见;Sara 希望本队这次能赢。

questions.stem: When is the basketball match?
Who is the city team playing against?
What does Sara remember about the two teams?
options: Our team lost to them before.

questions.stem: What time will they meet at the gate?
What does Sara hope for?
options: That her team wins this time.

exercises.title: U3 听力·短文 A Basketball Star
exercises.speaker: uk_male
transcript: As a boy, one famous player learned the game on a poor backyard court.
Many coaches thought he was too short and too thin to succeed.
But he refused to give up and kept practising every day.
His accurate shooting and self-belief soon surprised everyone.
His story shows that hard work matters more than what others think of you.
exercises.translation_cn: 一位著名球员小时候是在简陋的后院球场上学球的;许多教练觉得他太矮太瘦难以成功;但他拒绝放弃,每天坚持练习;他精准的投篮和自信很快让所有人吃惊;他的故事说明努力比别人怎么看你更重要。

questions.stem: Where did the player learn the game as a boy?
What did many coaches think about him?
options: That he was already a star.
That he was too short and thin to succeed.
That he should be the coach.

questions.stem: What did he do instead of giving up?
What soon surprised everyone?
What does his story show?
options: Hard work matters more than others' opinions.
Talent is the only thing that counts.
It is best to give up early.

exercises.title: U3 听力·对话 After Losing the Game
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Leo: We lost the final by just two points. I feel terrible.
Anna: I know it hurts, but you all played really well.
Leo: Maybe I should just quit the team.
Anna: Don't say that. It is no use giving up after one loss.
Leo: But we trained so hard for this match.
Anna: And that hard work will pay off next time. One game does not decide everything.
Leo: You're right. I shouldn't blame myself so much.
Anna: Exactly. Keep going, and the team will only get stronger.
exercises.translation_cn: Leo 因决赛仅以两分之差落败而难过,甚至想退队;Anna 安慰他,说大家都打得很好,输一场就放弃毫无意义;并说刻苦训练下次会有回报,一场比赛决定不了一切;Leo 想通了,不再过分自责;Anna 鼓励他坚持下去,球队会越来越强。

questions.stem: Why does Leo feel terrible?
options: They lost the final by two points.

questions.stem: What does Leo say he might do?
What does Anna think about giving up after one loss?
options: It is no use giving up.

questions.stem: What does Anna say about their hard work?
options: It will pay off next time.

exercises.title: U3 听力·短文 Why We Do Sport
exercises.speaker: uk_male
transcript: Doing sport is good for both the body and the mind.
After a long day of study, a short run can clear your head.
Playing team games also teaches you to work well with others.
And learning to lose with a smile makes you stronger inside.
So find a sport you enjoy, and make it a part of your life.
exercises.translation_cn: 运动对身体和心灵都有好处;在长时间学习后,短跑能让头脑清醒;团队比赛还能教你与他人协作;学会微笑着面对失败会让内心更强大;所以找一项你喜欢的运动,让它成为生活的一部分。

questions.stem: What is sport good for, according to the passage?
options: Both the body and the mind.

questions.stem: What can a short run do after a long day of study?
options: Make you tired for a week.

questions.stem: What do team games teach you?
What makes you stronger inside?

questions.stem: What does the speaker tell you to do?
